summary: Implements the `tsconfig-sync` CLI command that synchronizes root tsconfig references/aliases, tstyche.json, syncpack.config.ts sources, per-package tsconfig references, and package docgen.json files across the workspace. One 1784-line file currently holds the schemas, workspace-descriptor discovery, jsonc/file IO plumbing, six planner functions, orchestration (`syncTsconfigAtRoot`), console rendering, and the Command tree.

concerns.name: Command data schemas and derived guards
concerns.description: Brands (CanonicalAliasKey, BeepScopedPackageName, RootDepIndexKey), LiteralKit mode/section kits, the tagged unions TsconfigSyncRunOptions / TsconfigSyncChange / PlannedFileChange / TsconfigSyncResult (15 S.Class case classes), WorkspaceDescriptor, TsconfigWithReferences/TsconfigWithPaths/TsconfigReferenceEntry/TsconfigCompilerOptionsPaths, plus derived S.is guards, equivalences, and Order instances (lines 88-131, 172-697).

concerns.name: JSONC/JSON parsing and file IO plumbing
concerns.description: DomainError-wrapped fs read/write, jsonc parse/format/modify helpers, JSON render, root package.json reader, and posix-path normalizers (lines 73-79, 699-790).

concerns.name: Workspace discovery and alias-target computation
concerns.description: Builds WorkspaceDescriptor per package (resolveWorkspaceDirs + collectTsConfigPaths + package.json decode + exports-derived alias targets), dependency adjacency maps, subpath/source-only alias target derivation, and canonical alias entry expansion (lines 132-170, 791-813, 921-1045, 1099-1166, 1280-1299).

concerns.name: Tstyche and syncpack canonical-content domain logic
concerns.description: Pure text/domain logic computing canonical tstyche testFileMatch globs from workspace patterns and regex-based read/replace of the syncpack.config.ts source array (lines 815-919).

concerns.name: Per-target sync planners
concerns.description: Six Effect planner functions producing Option/array of PlannedFileChange for root references, root aliases, root tstyche, root syncpack, package references (with topo-sort + existing-ref canonicalization), and package docgen, plus filter resolution and change sorting/mapping (lines 1047-1097, 1168-1278, 1301-1563).

concerns.name: Run orchestration (public API)
concerns.description: syncTsconfigAtRoot dual-arity Effect.fn: builds descriptors + dep index, detects cycles, runs all planners, writes in sync mode, raises TsconfigSyncDriftError in check mode, and constructs the TsconfigSyncResult union. Consumed by CreatePackage/Handler.ts and tests (lines 1595-1707).

concerns.name: Console rendering
concerns.description: renderChanges prints mode-matched drift/apply summaries; summaryCounts formats add/remove/reorder counts; verbose per-package Console.log lives inline in planPackageReferenceSync (lines 1047-1061, 1565-1593, 1478-1485).

concerns.name: Command tree and flag-to-mode wiring
concerns.description: tsconfigSyncCommand flag definitions, predicate-tuple resolveMode (check/dry-run/write precedence), and catchTags error-to-exit-code adaptation via failWithReportedExit (lines 199-203, 1709-1784).

concerns.name: Re-export shim of repo-utils alias helpers
concerns.description: Re-exports buildCanonicalAliasTargets and resolveRootExportTarget from @beep/repo-utils/schemas/TsconfigAliasTargets through this command file (lines 50-65), leaking library symbols through the command facade.

proposedSplit.contents: All brands, LiteralKit mode/section kits, the four tagged unions with their 15 case classes, WorkspaceDescriptor, Tsconfig* shape classes, JsonObject/StringArray, and derived guards/equivalences/Order instances. New $I module path 'commands/TsconfigSync/TsconfigSync.schemas'.

FORMATTING_OPTIONS, parseJsonc, parseJsonObject, renderJson, applyJsoncModification, readFileString, writeFileString, readRootPackageJson, relativeFromRoot, normalizeRelativeRef, uniqueSorted, arraysEqual, referenceEntries. Candidate for later promotion to src/internal/cli/Jsonc.ts (see sharedCandidates).

buildWorkspaceDescriptors, buildAdjacency, buildSubsetAdjacency, dependencyNamesFromWorkspaceDeps, chooseOwnerTsconfig, workspaceContainsPath, workspacePatternsFromPackageJson, alias-target derivation (buildPackageSubpathAliasTargets, buildSourceOnlySubpathAliasTargets, source-only test-kit alias tables, canonicalAliasEntriesForWorkspace, pathValuesEqual, packageSubpathAlias, sourceAliasTarget).

Tstyche canonical testFileMatch logic (buildCanonicalTstycheTestFileMatch, workspacePatternCoversPath, isManagedTstycheWorkspace, readTstycheTestFileMatch/Tsconfig, pathSegments, readStringArray) and syncpack source-array regex read/render/replace (readSyncpackSources, replaceSyncpackSources, buildCanonicalSyncpackSources).

The six planner Effect.fns (planRootReferenceSync, planRootAliasSync, planRootTstycheSync, planRootSyncpackSync, planPackageReferenceSync, planPackageDocgenSync) plus resolveTargetWorkspacesForPackageSync, canonicalizeExistingRefTarget, compareReferencePathsInOrder, sortChanges, toReportedChange.
renderChanges and summaryCounts; also home the verbose per-package log line currently inlined in planPackageReferenceSync if it is extracted as a render helper.

syncTsconfigAtRoot (the dual-arity orchestrator) and the TsconfigSyncError type alias; this is the programmatic API used by CreatePackage/Handler.ts and tests. Optionally formalize as a Context.Service contract + default layer later — keep the exported function signature identical in this split.

Slimmed to tsconfigSyncCommand, resolveMode, the mode-flag predicate tuples, and the catchTags -> failWithReportedExit adaptation (~130 LOC). Drop the inline re-export shim of repo-utils alias helpers (move it to index.ts if the facade must keep exporting them).

Curated facade re-exporting: tsconfigSyncCommand, syncTsconfigAtRoot, all public schemas (TsconfigSyncMode/RunOptions/Section/Change, PlannedFileChange, TsconfigSyncResult, WorkspaceDescriptor, TsconfigWithReferences, TsconfigWithPaths), the errors module, and the buildCanonicalAliasTargets/resolveRootExportTarget re-exports; internal/ files stay private.

sharedCandidates.description: jsonc.modify + applyEdits wrapper with the repo's 2-space formatting options. Verbatim duplicates exist at CreatePackage/Handler.ts:511/660, CreatePackage/ConfigUpdater.ts:132/263, and VersionSync/internal/updaters/PackageJsonUpdater.ts:20 uses the same inline pattern.
Schema-typed JSONC decode with per-file DomainError context; generic over any schema. Same pattern re-implemented wherever tsconfig/biome jsonc files are parsed.

Thin FileSystem wrappers mapping failures to DomainError with file path context; overlaps @beep/repo-utils FsUtils (FsUtils.ts:218-244 already wraps read/write). Should defer to FsUtils rather than a new shared module.
Normalizes package.json `workspaces` (array or {packages}) into a string array. Belongs next to resolveWorkspaceDirs in @beep/repo-utils/Workspaces rather than command-local code.
Formats add/remove/reorder diff counts between two string arrays; generic drift-summary rendering usable by any check/sync-style command.
Tiny generic collection helpers (HashSet-dedupe+sort, string-array equivalence, safe unknown->string[] read); @beep/utils-grade if not already present there.
Canonical JSON file rendering; overlaps src/internal/cli/Json.ts (CliJsonError/encodeJson) — reconcile with that module instead of duplicating.

Hardcoded per-package test-kit alias data is configuration, not logic; if it grows beyond two packages it should become data-driven (package.json field or repo-utils schema) rather than a command-local table.

risks: Public facade breakage: test/tsconfig-sync.test.ts imports { syncTsconfigAtRoot, tsconfigSyncCommand } from @beep/repo-cli/commands/TsconfigSync and CreatePackage/Handler.ts:35 imports syncTsconfigAtRoot from ../TsconfigSync/index.js; index.ts currently does `export *` from the command file, so every currently-exported symbol (including WorkspaceDescriptor, PlannedFileChange, TsconfigWithReferences/Paths, and the re-exported buildCanonicalAliasTargets/resolveRootExportTarget) must be re-exported explicitly from the new facade or downstream imports break.

$I identity drift: schemas moving to TsconfigSync.schemas.ts change their $RepoCliId module path from 'commands/TsconfigSync/TsconfigSync.command'; standards/schema-catalog.generated.jsonc and standards/jsdoc-documentation.inventory.{md,jsonc} are tracked files that embed the old path and must be regenerated or the deterministic-catalog gate fails.

Lint REQUIRED_TAGGED_UNIONS gate (Lint.command.ts:66-73, scan at :338): it regex-scans tooling files for `const TsconfigSyncRunOptions/TsconfigSyncChange/PlannedFileChange/TsconfigSyncResult =` and requires mapMembers + Tuple.evolve + .pipe(S.toTaggedUnion(...)) within a 1400-char snippet of the declaration — the union declarations must move intact (case classes declared nearby) and keep that exact shape.

Behavioral ordering: planner execution order (root refs -> aliases -> tstyche -> syncpack -> package refs -> docgen), sortChanges (file-then-section Order), and the dual(2, ...) data-first/data-last signature of syncTsconfigAtRoot are asserted by test/tsconfig-sync.test.ts (13+ call sites incl. drift-tag assertions) and used by CreatePackage/Handler.ts:1234 — preserve all three exactly.

Type-signature drift: syncTsconfigAtRoot's declared R channel (FileSystem | Path | FsUtils | ChildProcessSpawner, the latter two inherited from repo-utils fns) and the TsconfigSyncError union are load-bearing for Handler.ts layer provision; re-deriving them after the split could silently widen/narrow and surface as distant type errors under the turbo check cascade.

Docgen/JSDoc ratchet: every symbol exported from the new role files needs compliant @example/@category/@since JSDoc (jsdoc ratchet is blocking for the tooling family), and @example imports must go through the facade path @beep/repo-cli/commands/TsconfigSync, not deep role files.
